content:
Requirement R11 (input): Input New UAV Parameters. Fixed modalities: Touch and Keyboard. Intent: Allow the pilot to set new operating parameters for a UAV..

We will design this requirement in three sequential layers, all within THIS conversation: Function first, then Behaviour, then Structure. Conduct the sequence yourself — when a layer is agreed, state its final label clearly and move to the next.
- Functions: propose 2-3 genuinely distinct candidates labeled F-11.1, F-11.2, ... Distinct means each opens a different interaction goal — not the same goal reworded.
- Behaviours: 2-3 distinct interaction flows, labeled Be-11.<F>.1, Be-11.<F>.2, ... using the closed F index.
- Structures: 2-3 distinct sets of concrete HMI elements, labeled S-11.<F>.<Be>.1, ... using the closed F and Be indices.

Start with the Function candidates now (state the intent back first). The designer closes the whole requirement at the end.

**Intent restated:** Let the pilot set new operating parameters (speed, altitude, heading) for a UAV under control.

**Function candidates:**

- **F-11.1 — Pilot submits new UAV flight parameters.** Goal: the pilot's intended parameter values (speed/altitude/heading) become the UAV's commanded targets. This is the core teleology of R11 — the artefact exists to get the pilot's chosen values into the UAV.

- **F-11.2 — Pilot is made aware the UAV accepted the new parameters.** Goal: closure on the round-trip acknowledgment (use-case steps 5.2.5–5.2.8). Distinct goal — awareness of acceptance, not the setting itself.

- **F-11.3 — Pilot references the UAV's current attitude before setting values.** Goal: convey current UAV state so the pilot sets meaningful values. This maps to use-case 5.1 (UAV Attitude Status), a distinct informational goal.

**Recommendation:** F-11.1 is the true spine of R11 ("Input New UAV Parameters"). F-11.2 is really an R08-family notification (acknowledgment delivery already covered by the notification pattern), and F-11.3 belongs to use-case 5.1 which is a separate monitoring capability. I'd close R11 on **F-11.1** and flag the other two as belonging to already-defined patterns (R08) or a separate requirement (5.1).

Which do you want to carry forward?

**F-11.1 and F-11.2 carried forward.**

Note on F-11.2: the acknowledgment-delivery mechanism (redundant audio + visual) is already the **R08 notification pattern**. So F-11.2's Behaviour/Structure should reuse R08, not invent new — I'll flag that as we go.

Moving to **Behaviour**.

---

**For F-11.1 (submit new UAV flight parameters):**

- **Be-11.1.1 — Direct value entry (primary).** Pilot opens a UAV parameter panel, enters speed/altitude/heading values directly (numeric keypad on WAD or UCP/bezel keyboard), commits. Mirrors Be-01.1 (AP setpoint direct entry). Modality-complete: full task via Touch keypad alone or UCP/bezel alone.

- **Be-11.1.2 — Step/increment adjustment (complement).** Pilot nudges each parameter up/down via on-screen steppers (Touch) or bezel rotary (Keyboard). Good for small corrections under vibration. Mirrors Be-01.2.

- **Be-11.1.3 — Preset parameter profiles.** Pilot selects a stored profile (e.g. "loiter", "transit") that populates all three values at once, then commits. Mirrors Be-01.3 preset logic.

**Recommendation:** This is structurally the **same family as R01** (AP target setting) — three values, direct/step/preset triad. I'd close F-11.1 on **Be-11.1.1 primary + Be-11.1.2 and Be-11.1.3 as complements**, exactly reusing the R01 pattern. Flagging strong reuse: the setpoint-panel behaviour is shared, only the value set (UAV params vs AP targets) differs.

---

**For F-11.2 (awareness of UAV acceptance):**

- **Be-11.2.1 — Redundant ack notification (R08 reuse).** On UAV acknowledgment, fire the shared R08 audio tone + visual pop-up/marker. Modality-complete on output.

**Recommendation:** Only one sensible Behaviour here — it's the R08 notification pattern applied to the param-accepted event. Close F-11.2 on **Be-11.2.1 (= R08 reuse)**.

Agree on the Behaviour set, or want a distinct flow for F-11.2?

Great
Agreed on all of them

**Behaviour closed:**
- F-11.1 → **Be-11.1.1** (direct entry, primary) + **Be-11.1.2** (step) + **Be-11.1.3** (preset)
- F-11.2 → **Be-11.2.1** (redundant ack notification, R08 reuse)

---

Moving to **Structure**.

**For F-11.1 (Be-11.1.1 / .2 / .3):**

- **S-11.1.1.1 — UAV Parameter Panel (new WAD panel, R01-pattern clone).**
  - Three parameter rows (speed / altitude / heading), each with: numeric field + keypad (Touch, Be-11.1.1), ± steppers (Touch, Be-11.1.2), and a preset selector row (Touch, Be-11.1.3).
  - Bezel rotary maps to selected-row stepping + UCP alphanumeric for direct value entry (Keyboard path, all three behaviours).
  - Commit/Send affordance (Touch OSS + bezel OSS).
  - Both paths modality-complete.
  - **Reuse flag:** this is the R01 Setpoint Panel structure re-instantiated with UAV param semantics. Widget types (keypad/steppers/presets), rotary mapping, and commit OSS are all shared component classes — only the data binding (UAV vs aircraft AP) and preset content differ. Not duplicated hardware; same on-screen component family.

**For F-11.2 (Be-11.2.1):**

- **S-11.2.1.1 — Ack via shared R08 notification stack.**
  - Audio tone (shared Audio system notify channel) + reusable multi-mode pop-up + notification-marker + messages-tab entry (all R08 components).
  - No new structure; parameter-accepted event routed into existing notification components.
  - **Reuse flag:** entirely R08-shared.

---

**Recommendation:** Close R11 structure on **S-11.1.1.1** (UAV Parameter Panel, R01-family clone) + **S-11.2.1.1** (R08 notification reuse). Both are shared-component instantiations, not new hardware or novel widgets.

Want any variation on the panel (e.g. co-locating with the UAV detail panel from R09/R10 rather than a standalone panel), or close here?

**R11 closed.**

Final:
- **F-11.1** — Pilot submits new UAV flight parameters
  - **Be-11.1.1** direct value entry (primary) + **Be-11.1.2** step/increment + **Be-11.1.3** preset profiles
  - **S-11.1.1.1** — UAV Parameter Panel (WAD): 3 rows (speed/altitude/heading) with keypad + steppers + preset selector (Touch), bezel rotary + UCP alphanumeric (Keyboard), commit OSS; both paths modality-complete. *R01 Setpoint-Panel component family re-instantiated with UAV param semantics.*
- **F-11.2** — Pilot made aware UAV accepted new parameters
  - **Be-11.2.1** redundant ack notification (R08 reuse)
  - **S-11.2.1.1** — shared R08 notification stack (audio tone + multi-mode pop-up + notification-marker + messages-tab); no new structure.

Reuse logged: R11 rides on R01 (parameter-setting pattern) and R08 (notification pattern).
